background: DBS is Singapore's largest bank and the largest in Southeast Asia, with Temasek as its largest shareholder, funded by Singapore dollar deposits and lending across Singapore, Hong Kong, Greater China, India and Indonesia.
synthesis: All three main agencies rate the bank, AA on average with the weakest at AA-, all on a stable outlook, with no rating action in the last 90 days. Its ratios sit at or just above the Asian peer median across the board: CET1 of 15.9%, leverage of 5.7%, LCR of 146% and NSFR of 115%. Since 30 Sep 2025 CET1 has fallen 1.0 points and leverage 0.5 points, while liquidity has held steady (figures to 30 Sep 2026). The strength here is the rating, among the highest of any bank on the site.
